mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past 3 months signals robust economic output, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when INDPRO increases by at least 0.5% over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 6.0% signals a tight labor market that may lead to higher inflation and subsequent monetary tightening, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when UNRATE falls below 6.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and rise in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a robust economic expansion with strong labor market conditions and rising output, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when UNRATE falls by at least 0.2% and INDPRO rises by at least 0.5% over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening regime (FEDFUNDS > 3.0%), a rising CPIAUCSL (inflation) signals potential central bank hawkishness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when FEDFUNDS > 3.0% and CPIAUCSL rises by at least 0.2% over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 800.0 thousand units signals a weakening housing market, a key component of consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when HOUST falls below 800.0.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) over the past quarter signals robust economic expansion, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of quarters when GDPC1 growth (quarter-over-quarter) is positive.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL) and federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates an active monetary tightening cycle, which increases discount rates and compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when CPIAUCSL rises by at least 0.3% and FEDFUNDS rises by at least 0.1% over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) exceeding 200.0 thousand signals a strong labor market that may lead to higher inflation and subsequent monetary tightening, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when PAYEMS increases by more than 200.0 (thousands).
